proposal.observation: ZN-E001 (masked pooling on the CPMLP encoder) broke the ZN-E000 collapse: MAPE 0.3451, Acc@15 0.3405, RMSE 456 (pred SD 101 vs target SD 407, corr 0.26). Main limit: long-life cells are underpredicted (500-1000: MAPE 0.616, bias -511; >1000: MAPE 0.863, bias -1071; Acc@15 0 on all 5 cells >500). User rule 2026-11-08: no CPMLP-family candidates in v6.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: Replacing the flat per-cycle MLP (one Linear over 900 values + 5 MLP blocks) with a residual Conv1D curve encoder that reads local V/I/Q curve shape (inflections, plateau length) gives cycle features that separate long-life cells: >700-cycle MAPE below 0.764 and overall MAPE below 0.3371 (ZN-E001 - 0.008) or Acc@15 above 0.3605, with the masked summary keeping the collapse fixed.
proposal.question_inherited: Can a non-CPMLP mask-safe architecture keep the collapse fix and reduce long-life underprediction on ZN-coin?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Whether the long-life underprediction is a representation limit of the flat per-cycle MLP / lack of temporal modelling, or a loss/data-imbalance limit (15 of 20 val cells <500 cycles).
proposal.why_this_experiment: User excludes CPMLP; this is the first fully non-CPMLP model and changes exactly one stage vs ZN-E001 (architecture.md §5 staging Run B order reversed because the CPMLP encoder may not be held). architecture.md §3: curve inflection loss -> Conv1D curve encoder. Masked causal TCN follows in ZN-E003 with a mask-aware norm (Codex review of the first ZN-E002 draft).
proposal.modification: Curve Encoder only: intra_embed Linear(900->64) + 5 MLP blocks -> Conv1D stem (3->32->64->64, kernels 7/5/3, strides 2) + 2 residual curve blocks (GroupNorm over the 38 curve positions of each cycle, never across cycles) + average pool -> [B,100,64]. Masked mean/last/last-first summary, Linear(192->64), 9 MLP blocks (d_ff 64, dropout 0.1) and head are unchanged from ZN-E001.
proposal.changed_components: Curve encoder (per-cycle MLP -> residual Conv1D). Lead code change: build_model passes dropout to residual_conv_masked_summary (default 0.0 unchanged).
proposal.held_constant_components: Masked summary pooling, inter Linear(192->64), 9 MLP blocks d_ff 64 dropout 0.1, head, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epoch rule, data.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: Overall MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE vs ZN-E001; EOL-band MAPE and bias (500-1000, >1000); prediction SD/target SD and correlation; gradient ratios; padding sensitivity; params/time.
proposal.rejection_condition: DISCARD if MAPE is not below 0.3371 and Acc@15 not above 0.3605 vs ZN-E001, or predictions collapse (SD < 10% target SD). Invalid under the usual protocol/finite/epoch checks.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; CPMLP block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.

architecture_addendum.evidence: ZN-E001 long-life underprediction (Acc@15 0 for >500 cycles) with flat per-cycle MLP and no temporal model; user excludes CPMLP
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> [B*100,3,300] -> Conv stem [B*100,64,38] -> 2 residual blocks -> avgpool -> [B,100,64] -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> 9 MLP blocks -> head [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: Curves of padded cycles are zero and are encoded independently per cycle (GroupNorm only within one cycle's 38 positions); only mask==1 cycles enter mean, last at mask.sum()-1, delta = last - cycle1.
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE vs ZN-E001 and paper (CPMLP 0.558/0.297, CPTransformer 0.515/0.202); EOL-band errors; pred/target SD; gradient ratio
